intake.duplicate_effort: none -- no AMD-Ecosystem/ROCm repo, all 33 upstream forks vanilla, no AMD mention in upstream docs
intake.summary: ROS2 dynamic-object SLAM (BSD-3, 327 stars, active): its GPU-critical half is cv::cuda PyrLK/GoodFeatures, already ported and validated by our own opencv_contrib on gfx1100, and its own CUDA is one 327-line .cu; what decides it is whether we accept reimplementing its raw-TensorRT YOLOv8 inference on MIGraphX (no ONNX Runtime layer exists) inside a ROS2 + GTSAM + from-source-OpenCV stack.
